mentions.name: DataRaven
mentions.description: A managed rclone platform for object storage that lets teams run cloud-to-cloud transfers, migrations, and scheduled syncs without owning infrastructure. It adds operational features rclone lacks out of the box: notifications, centralized logs, team access, audit logs, and analytics such as bytes transferred, objects changed, and failure rates. It also offers a guided onboarding flow, support for more storage providers, and bring-your-own-vault (BYOV) secret support.
mentions.problem: rclone lacks operational features out of the box such as notifications, centralized logs, team access, audit logs, and transfer analytics.
mentions.audience: Teams running cloud-to-cloud transfers, migrations, and scheduled syncs without having to own any infrastructure.

mentions.name: Dataraven
mentions.description: A low-cost, cloud-agnostic data movement platform focused on object storage that wraps rclone for reliable, fast cloud-to-cloud transfers. It adds operational features including team workspaces with role-based access control and full audit logs, transfer failure and resource change notifications via Slack, Teams, or JSON webhooks, centralized log storage and archiving, bring-your-own-vault integrations (1Password, Doppler, Infisical) for zero-knowledge credential handling, API keys, rclone.conf import for rapid onboarding, and 10 Gbps connected infrastructure for large transfers.
mentions.problem: Cloud-to-cloud object storage transfers lack the operational features—access control, auditing, notifications, and secure credential handling—that clients need, which this platform wraps around rclone.

mentions.description: A low-cost, cloud-native data movement platform focused on object storage, built on top of RClone. It adds operational features including team workspaces with role-based access control, alerts on transfer failures or resource changes via Slack, Teams, and Discord, centralized log storage, zero-knowledge credential handling through vault integrations with 1Password, Doppler, or Infisical, and 10 Gbps connected infrastructure on the Pro tier for large transfers.
mentions.problem: RClone handles the data movement itself but lacks the operational features clients need, such as team access control, notifications, centralized logging, and credential management.
